text:
Alex (Partnerships): quick sync — vendor roadmap + marketplace wave planning. can we align dates for H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi compatibility windows?
Priya (Product): need to lock marketing announcement windows 2 weeks before marketplace listings. priority: Dedicated + Private packaging.
Sofia (Partner Sales): sales want single-day enablement for customers on Dedicated; marketplace listing should include pricing tiers and SKUs.
nvidia_pm: NVIDIA timeline — H200 fleet refresh planned mid-June, driver stack droppoint w/ MKL and NCCL updates by 6/12. we can provide early images 6/5 for canary.
amd_pm: AMD MI300 production ramp targets late June; ROCm 6.2 with kernel fixes by 6/20. we can share CI images 6/13.
gaudi_pm: Gaudi v2 nodes arriving staggered — we expect lab access starting 6/18. firmware updates will be required, will share notes.
Mateo (Eng-runtime): thanks — for canaries we need vendor images at least 7 business days before any public marketplace listing so we can run perf + stress. request: give us early AMIs/VMs with root access and driver versions pinned.
Jing (Eng-ML): ML infra needs quantization/ops profiling on each stack. plan: run 3 perf kits (chat p99 latency, throughput gen, embedding throughput). estimate 5 days per kit per vendor.
Alex (Partnerships): ok so rough timeline: early images 6/5-6/18, eng testing 6/6-6/25, canary customers 6/26-7/2, marketplace listing targeting 7/10. does that work?
amd_pm: MI300 testing window tight but doable if images on 6/13. we'll aim for that.
nvidia_pm: can provide H200 images 6/5 and H100 refresh artifacts 6/8.
gaudi_pm: lab images 6/18, but we can prioritize a small Gaudi cluster earlier if you need it — will confirm by EOD.
Sofia (Partner Sales): please tag sales in the canary list. we need 3 case studies and enablement docs before 7/10.
Priya (Product): docs owners: Priya + Jing for perf tables, Mateo for deployment guides. Marketing needs final messaging by 6/30.
Mateo (Eng-runtime): action items: vendor images links, kernel/driver manifest, recommended kernel cmdline, and a small repro for NV_swift (or ROCm) regressions. pls attach to the thread.
Jing (Eng-ML): also need sample prompt sets and eval harness for quality regression checks (structured outputs + hallucination checks).
Alex (Partnerships): contingency: if MI300 ramp slips, we shift MI300 to marketplace wave 2 (late July) but still list H200/H100/Gaudi. everyone ok?
amd_pm: we'll flag ASAP if risk > 20% — prefer to avoid split wave but understandable.
nvidia_pm: we can absorb more volume if MI300 slips; provide consolidated perf summaries so customers can pick.
deploy-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://redwood.internal/deploys/gpu-marketplace-wave1 (created by deploy-bot) :white_check_mark:
Sofia (Partner Sales): one more ask — joint co-marketing with vendors. nvidia_pm / amd_pm / gaudi_pm can you confirm logos + co-branding T&Cs by 6/22?
gaudi_pm: will send legal contact and draft assets by 6/21.
amd_pm: will loop legal; expect consent by 6/22.
nvidia_pm: legal okay with standard co-marketing NDA, will send assets 6/20.
Alex (Partnerships): perfect. final checklist for next sync: 1) image links + manifests 2) test run schedule + owners 3) canary customer list 4) docs + marketing draft 5) legal signoffs. next sync Tue 6/23 9am PT.
Priya (Product): noted — I'll prepare a draft announcement timeline and share by 6/24.
Mateo (Eng-runtime): will start perf baseline runs as soon as images arrive and post summaries here.
Jing (Eng-ML): will run evals and post comparison matrix (latency, throughput, gen-quality).
Alex (Partnerships): thanks all — feel free to DM if blockers. :thumbsup:
